stories.title: Families meet potential forever pets during LMAS' 'Tailgate Adoption Pawty'
stories.summary: The organization said this is something new to showcase all of the cats and dogs available for adoption.

stories.title: Suspect in custody after person injured in Jeffersonville shooting
stories.summary: Police say they are investigating after a person was shot in the area of Hamburg Pike and Woodlawn Avenue Sunday evening.

stories.title: Jefferson County Sheriff's Office names new deputy chief
stories.summary: The department has named a new deputy chief as outgoing Deputy Chief Col. Steve Healey heads to a new role in California.

stories.title: Volunteers urgently needed for White Flag Shelter in New Albany as winter approaches
stories.summary: The Opportunity Alliance of Southern Indiana is calling on the community for volunteers for its White Flag Shelter as colder temperatures arrive.

stories.title: Flying out of Louisville for the holidays? Here are some tips to make travel easier
stories.summary: Airport officials say planning ahead is especially important this year, with more travelers expected to pass through SDF during Thanksgiving week.

stories.title: Flights resume at Louisville airport but effects of nationwide ground stop issues still linger
stories.summary: The airport saw 32 departing flights and 17 arriving flights canceled on Saturday, following 53 cancelations on Friday.

stories.title: Louisville restaurant staple Vincenzo's to close after 40 years
stories.summary: Vincenzo’s announced it will be closing at the end of the year, with its final day of business set for Dec. 31.

stories.title: Jefferson County sheriff’s chief deputy leaving for California agency
stories.summary: Steve Healey is joining the Monterey County Sheriff’s Office after more than 26 years serving Louisville.

stories.title: Travelers in Louisville make last minute plans to avoid a nationwide ground-stop
stories.summary: For four hours, plans at Louisville's international airport were blocked from taking off for their destinations, causing most travelers to rethink their plans.

stories.title: Bullitt County neighbors relieved as wastewater treatment plant in neighborhood is set to be eliminated
stories.summary: MSD is spending more than $10 million in upgrades for Bullitt County customers. New pumps will send wastewater to a modern plant in Jefferson County.

stories.title: Class action lawsuit filed against Kentucky Castle, ex-CEO following voyeurism claims
stories.summary: Kentucky Castle and former CEO Wes Henderson are accused of negligence and privacy invasion after allegations of secret recordings surfaced.

stories.title: NTSB releases preliminary report into Missouri plane crash that killed Simpsonville couple
stories.summary: The NTSB found the couple's plane departed from Jeffersonville, Indiana, at about 10 a.m. on Nov. 3.
